mentions.name: Stacks
mentions.description: Stacks is an open source ebook manager and server built as a lightweight alternative to Calibre. Written in Swift, it consists of a SwiftUI browser plus a Mac/Linux server and CLI. Shares are automatically discovered via Bonjour/avahi and published as OPDS feeds. It can import Calibre libraries and has basic support for managing books on Kindles.
mentions.problem: Provides a lightweight alternative to Calibre for managing and serving ebook libraries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m making Stacks, an open source ebook manager and server, as a lightweight alternative to Calibre.

Written in Swift, it consists of a SwiftUI browser and a Mac/Linux server and CLI. Shares are automatically discovered via Bonjour/avahi and also published as OPDS feeds.

It can import Calibre libraries and has basic support for managing books on Kindles
mentions.author: mattkevan
